Name: Mega Loot Magnet
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[heading][size=5]IMPORTANT[/size][/heading]
Renamed the mod to [b]Mega Loot Magnet. [/b]Because[b].[/b]

[size=4]I[/size][size=4]f you installed version [b]1.0.0[/b], delete the old [b]EnhancedLootMagnet [/b]folder before installing this version. Then double-check your GMCM settings.[/size]


[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Turn the mod on or off in-game.[/*]
[*]Scale your normal magnet range from [b]1x to 3x[/b].[/*]
[*]Or use [b]map-wide magnet range[/b] if walking over to the loot feels unreasonable.[/*]
[*]Scale loot pickup speed from [b]1x to 3x[/b].[/*]
[*]Or enable [b]instant teleport[/b] so loot skips the journey and drops directly into inventory.[/*]
[*]Remove the initial loot bounce so drops begin moving sooner.[/*]
[*]Protect items within your active magnet range from sinking into [b]water or lava[/b].[/*]
[*]Configure options through [b]GMCM[/b].[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Why this fork exists[/b][/size]
Because the loot was not using enough initiative. This fork is based on aedenthorn’s original loot magnet mod, with a fix for the drawing errors seen in come cases (Hello, tractor in the mines). Also includes a couple more qol features.



[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Based on [b]Enhanced Loot Magnet / MagnetMod[/b] by [b]aedenthorn[/b].
Thank you to aedenthorn for the original mod and open permissions.

Manifest.Name: Mega Loot Magnet
Manifest.Description: Improves loot magnet behavior with map-wide range, faster pickup, optional instant teleport, bounce removal, and liquid-sink protection.
Manifest.Author: MiscMemos
